attributes.board_name: Florida Board of Speech-Language Pathology & Audiology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved courses in CE Broker; courses from ASHA-approved providers or approved by the American Academy of Audiology meeting rule 64B20-6.002. Also: 2 ethics hours per year for attending a Board meeting; max 5 h presenting/moderating; max 5 h teaching a graduate course; max 2 h non-paid directed clinical experience; graduate courses at 15 hours per semester hour (prior approval).
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: licensed after July 1 of an odd year – exempt; licensed Jan 1–Jun 30 of an odd year – 18 clinically related hours + 2-hour medical errors course; licensed in an even year – full 30 hours.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; documentation due within 21 days of request; keep records 2 years after renewal.

topics.who: Board-approved prevention of medical errors course

rules.legal_basis: Fla. Admin. Code R. 64B20-6.001; Fla. Stat. § 468.1195
rules.notes: 30 hours = 18 clinically related + 10 general (may also be clinical) + 2 medical errors; rule text: at least 20 clinically related. Dual SLP + audiology licensees: 50 hours per biennium, 40 clinically related (20 in each specialty), incl. 2 medical errors. Licenses expire December 31 of odd years (current cycle ends Dec 31, 2027).

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved, clinically related CE (CE Broker listed, ASHA- or AAA-approved courses); same alternative credit options as licensees.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: certified 6 months or less before the end of the biennium – exempt; certified in the first half of the biennium – full 20 hours.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; documentation due within 21 days of request.

topics.who: Board-approved prevention of medical errors course

rules.notes: Certified speech-language pathology assistants and audiology assistants: 20 clinically related hours per biennium (18 + 2 medical errors).
